name: Mullvad Browser
description: Privacy-focused browser from Mullvad and Tor Project
about: Privacy-focused browser built with the Tor Project. Makes all users look alike to reduce fingerprinting, without using the Tor network.

name: Zoom Workplace
about: Video meeting and collaboration app with chat, screen sharing, webinars and virtual backgrounds. A free plan has time limits on group meetings.

name: Slack
about: Team messaging organized into channels, with file sharing, integrations and huddles. Free for small teams with limited history.

name: WhatsApp
about: Desktop version of WhatsApp for messaging, voice and video calls, synced with your phone account.

name: Mumble
about: Low-latency, high-quality voice chat with positional audio. Popular with gamers who want a self-hosted alternative to Discord voice.

name: Jitsi Meet Electron
description: Desktop client for Jitsi video meetings
about: Desktop app for Jitsi Meet, an open-source video conferencing service. Join or host meetings without creating an account.

name: Thunderbird Beta
about: Beta channel of Thunderbird. Gives you early access to upcoming email features, but may be less stable than the release version.

name: MPV
about: Minimalist, scriptable media player with excellent video quality and hardware decoding. Controlled by keyboard and config files rather than menus.

name: Kodi
about: Home theatre software that organizes and plays your movies, TV shows, music and photos on a 10-foot interface, with many add-ons.

name: Jellyfin Media Player
description: Desktop client for Jellyfin media servers
about: Desktop client for Jellyfin, the free self-hosted media server. Plays your own library with hardware-accelerated direct play.

name: Plex
about: Media library and streaming client that organizes your personal collection and connects to your Plex server. Some features need Plex Pass.

name: MusicBee
about: Feature-packed music manager and player with tagging, auto-playlists, podcasts and many skins. Free for personal use.

name: foobar2000
about: Highly customizable, lightweight audio player known for accurate playback and a large range of components.

name: AIMP
about: Audio player and library manager with a built-in equalizer, tag editor and support for many formats. Free to use.

name: LosslessCut
about: Quickly trim and cut video and audio files without re-encoding, so there is no quality loss and exports are very fast.

name: Shutter Encoder
about: Friendly front end for FFmpeg that converts and compresses video, audio and images, with presets for editing and delivery.

name: FFmpeg
description: Command-line audio and video toolkit build
about: The core command-line toolkit for converting, recording and processing audio and video. Powers many other media tools.

name: yt-dlp
about: Command-line downloader for video and audio from many websites. Actively maintained fork of youtube-dl with many extra features.

name: MediaInfo
about: Shows technical details of media files, such as codecs, bitrate, resolution and tags. Handy for checking what a file really contains.

name: Avidemux
about: Simple video editor for cutting, filtering and re-encoding. Good for quick, basic edits and format conversion.

name: Olive Video Editor
about: Free non-linear video editor with a node-based compositing approach. Still in development, so expect rough edges.

name: Natron
about: Node-based compositing and visual effects software. Similar in spirit to Nuke, used for keying, tracking and finishing shots.

name: FreeCAD
about: Parametric 3D CAD modeler for product design and engineering. Build models from sketches and change dimensions later.

name: MeshLab
about: Tool for processing and cleaning 3D meshes. Useful for scan data, repairing models and converting between formats.

name: Godot Engine
about: Open-source game engine for 2D and 3D games, with its own scripting language, scene system and export to many platforms.

name: LMMS
description: Digital audio workstation for music creation
about: Free digital audio workstation for making music, with a beat editor, synthesizers, samplers and VST plugin support.

name: Ardour
about: Professional-grade digital audio workstation for recording, editing and mixing multi-track audio.

name: MuseScore
about: Music notation software for writing, playing and printing sheet music. Supports MIDI input and a large online score community.

name: FontForge
description: Font editor for creating and modifying fonts
about: Editor for creating and modifying fonts. Draw glyphs, adjust metrics and export to common font formats.

name: FontBase
about: Font manager that helps you browse, preview and activate fonts. Includes Google Fonts integration. Free with optional paid features.

name: Paint.NET
about: Easy-to-use image editor with layers, effects and plugins. A big step up from Windows Paint while staying simple.

name: RawTherapee
about: Advanced RAW photo developer with detailed control over exposure, color and noise reduction. Non-destructive editing.

name: ExifTool
description: Read and edit image and media metadata
about: Reads, writes and edits metadata in images, video and documents. Powerful command-line tool for batch work.

name: ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors
description: Office suite for documents, sheets and presentations
about: Office suite for documents, spreadsheets and presentations with strong compatibility with Microsoft Office formats.

name: Apache OpenOffice
about: Classic open-source office suite with word processor, spreadsheet and presentation tools. A long-running alternative to LibreOffice.

name: Obsidian
about: Note-taking app that stores your notes as local Markdown files and links them into a graph. Extensible with community plugins. Free for personal use.

name: Joplin
about: Open-source notes and to-do app with Markdown, end-to-end encrypted sync and web clipper.

name: Logseq
about: Open-source outliner and knowledge base with daily journals and bidirectional links, stored as plain text files.

name: Zotero
about: Collects, organizes, cites and shares research. Saves references from the web and creates bibliographies in word processors.

name: Calibre
about: E-book manager that organizes your library, converts between formats and syncs with e-readers.

name: Okular
about: Universal document viewer from KDE for PDFs, ePub, comics and more, with annotation support.

name: PDFsam Basic
description: Split, merge, rotate and extract PDF pages
about: Simple tool to split, merge, rotate and extract pages from PDF files.

name: PDF Arranger
description: Rearrange, split and merge PDF pages
about: Small tool for rearranging, splitting and merging PDF pages with drag and drop.

name: Pandoc
about: Universal document converter between formats such as Markdown, HTML, Word and LaTeX. Command-line tool.

name: Typora
about: Markdown editor with a seamless live preview, so you write and see formatted text in the same window. Paid license after trial.

name: CherryTree
about: Hierarchical note-taking app with rich text and code highlighting, storing everything in a single file.

name: Standard Notes
about: End-to-end encrypted notes app focused on privacy and longevity. Syncs across devices; some extra features are paid.

name: Microsoft PC Manager
description: PC maintenance and storage management utility
about: Microsoft utility for cleaning up storage, managing startup apps and checking basic PC health.

name: EverythingToolbar
description: Windows taskbar search integration for Everything
about: Adds Everything's instant search to the Windows taskbar, so you can find files without opening another window.

name: Files
description: Modern open-source file manager for Windows
about: Modern file manager for Windows with tabs, dual panes, columns view and a polished interface.

name: Double Commander
about: Free dual-pane file manager inspired by Total Commander, with tabs, a built-in editor and plugin support.

name: FreeFileSync
about: Compares and synchronizes folders. Good for backups and mirroring between drives or network locations. Free to use.
